description: This file defines a utility class BsonAssertions providing custom assertion methods for Bson objects and collections of Bson in the context of testing, extending AssertJ's Assertions class.

classes.name: BsonAssertions
classes.description: Provides static factory methods for creating assertion objects for Bson and collections of Bson for testing purposes.

methods.name: assertThat
methods.description: Creates a BsonAssert for a Bson object.

methods.name: assertThat
methods.description: Creates a BsonCollectionAssert for a collection of Bson objects.
